title: Fabrication of sustainable composite films based on chitosan/deep eutectic solvent/tannic acid quantum dots for bioactive pork preservation
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6FB00103C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Malin Cui, Tongtong Li, Dongmei He, Miaoling Huang, Shuqin Chen
A biodegradable CS/DES/TAQDs composite film with strong UV-shielding, antioxidant and antibacterial properties was developed for pork packaging, extending pork shelf-life to 7 days at 4 °C.
